53369: Chaika is usually an optimistic girl that longs to help everyone, regardless of who they are.
53371: The protagonist is a Saboteur from the village of Acura. He has dark hair and eyes, but in the anime he has dark blue hair. After the downfall of the Gaz Empire and the return of peace, he has lost his way of life.
88274: A dragoon of Dominica who has the ability to shape-shift. She has been living in the shadows of Dominca after her death. After losing her battle with Toru's group, she takes on the form of a Lucie Skoda in honor of her master's late sister.
88275: A member of the Gillette Corps, and an Assassin who utilizes needles as weapons. She serves as the Corp's infiltrator, alongside Zita. She greatly adores Albéric but never finds the time to properly confess her feelings to him.
88276: The leader of the Gillette Corps. A cavalier from a noble family.
88277: Looks identical to "White Chaika", except her hair is in a shorter bowl cut, and she wears a different outfit which is red rather than white. Like White Chaika, her speech is distorted grammatically, and she also carries a giant coffin which has rollers and rope to pull along.
88278: She is identical to White and Red Chaika. Her main visual distinction is the makeup she wears. She is also fluent in the common language, unlike both White and Red Chaika, who speak in distorted sentences.
88279: A mysterious young man and Chaika's Trabant informant on the whereabouts of Arthur's remains. He appears as a hologram and helps Chaika and her companions quest.
88280: A female Wizard serving in the Gillette Corps. She specializes in magic vehicles, and is the main operator of the Corps' personal vehicle "April." She has a crush on Albéric, but supports Viivi in her attempts to gain his attention.
88281: The son of Duke Gavarni. States that he enjoys dismembering people. He works along Grad Lancia and Layla.
88282: One of the Eight Heroes and the Dragoon Cavalier. She is the Lord of Ipsom, but lives outside of the city limits, in her family's mansion in the forest. Because of this, she is rarely seen by the city's denizens, and many rumors have sprung up about her as a result.
88283: An artificially created demihuman, bred for the purpose of scouting. Serves under the Gillette Corps as their scout and tracker.
88284: An Acura Saboteur, and the childhood mentor of Tooru and Akari.
202540: The second-in-command of the Gillette Corps. A mercenary.
202541: A male wizard who can control creatures.
209086: A wizard who, like Chaika, carries a magic rifle. She is a companion of Red Chaika alongside David, and acts as the support of their group, much like Chaika does hers.
209090: A companion of Red Chaika. Fights with a spear, and is often subject to physical punishment (from Selma AND Red Chaika) due to his remarks.
